alignments.note: Construct noun of the superscription; the supplied indefinite *A* belongs to the nominal expression it determines under rule 15 and is not `added`.

Article on the rectum; the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase (*A Song of Ascents*), so the article is `unrepresented` under rule 29. The construct carries a supplied indefinite article instead, so nothing is fronted.
Nomen rectum with the chain's relational *of*, headed on the noun under rules 19 and 24.
Predicate of a verbless clause; the construction-supplied copula *is* joins the predicate under rule 20 and the unit heads on the word carrying the lexeme.

Quantifying construct noun; the generic *one* the ASV supplies to expand it joins its unit under rule 31 and the head stays on *every*, which carries the lexeme. No *of* is written for the chain, so rule 19 has nothing to place here.

Anarthrous substantival adjective in construct; the supplied relative *that* joins its own unit under rule 46, headed on the word carrying the lexeme. No article morpheme stands on it, so rule 41 does not govern.
Rectum of the construct relation, rendered as the bare object of *feareth*.
Attributive/substantival article rendered by a relative rather than a *the*; the article takes that relative and heads on it under rule 41.
Participle rendered as the finite predicate of the relative clause.
Preposition with its own written English word.
Noun; the possessive belongs to the suffix under rule 18.
Pronominal suffix realized by the possessive *his*.

review_notes: The superscription is aligned as ordinary source text: `שִׁיר` takes the supplied *A* under rule 15 and the determined-state rectum's article goes `unrepresented` under rule 29 because the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase.

`כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה`: *every one* is read as the quantifier with its supplied generic under rule 31 and *that feareth* as the anarthrous substantive with its supplied relative under rule 46. The competing reading would give *one that* jointly to `יְרֵא` as rule 46's *him that*; that was set aside because `כֹּל` is the construct quantifier and rule 31 places a generic supplied to expand it inside the quantifier's own unit.
